CustomField.description: Optional short-lived window in minutes (e.g. a download link/artifact validity), distinct from AXF_RPT_NUM_RetentionDays__c's day-granularity purge semantics (AXF-118). When present it expresses a minute-granularity window instead of a day-granularity retention; when absent this domain policy has no such window and only the day-based retention applies.
CustomField.label: Window Minutes
